# PHASE 05 — DETECTIVE ROOM UI

## OBJECTIVE

Build the signature visual identity.

## LANDING EXPERIENCE

The homepage should visually resemble a modern investigation room.

Suggested composition:

HEADER

CASE ROOM

LEFT / PRIMARY:

Investigator dossier
- name
- focus
- concise introduction
- system specialization

CENTER:

Investigation board

Project evidence cards connected by subtle lines.

RIGHT / SECONDARY:

System monitor
- Cloud
- DevOps
- Backend
- Data
- IoT

BOTTOM / DESK:

Terminal / technical log panel

Example content:

SYSTEM STATUS: ONLINE
CASES FOUND: 06
PRIMARY DOMAIN: CLOUD ENGINEERING
INVESTIGATION STATUS: ACTIVE

## PROJECT BOARD

Projects should visually behave as evidence.

Each card can show:

CASE #001
CATEGORY
TITLE
STATUS
TECH STACK

Hovering a case can highlight:

- related technologies
- related infrastructure
- other projects sharing the technology

Clicking opens the case file.

## IMPORTANT

Do not make the user solve a puzzle before they can access projects.

## RESPONSIVENESS

Desktop:

Full investigation room.

Tablet:

Simplified board.

Mobile:

Vertical investigation dashboard.

Do not merely shrink the desktop composition.

## EXIT CRITERIA

The homepage is visually distinctive, responsive, readable, and navigable.
